verdict.rationale: Vanta is an API-driven SaaS compliance platform, so a sandbox or test tenant is a fair question. The evidence pack shows no sandbox, test tenant, or non-production environment. The only alternate server documented is the Vanta Gov (FedRAMP) endpoint, which is a separate production region rather than a sandbox, and the MCP server and APIs act on real compliance data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
